sentences.en: I hope that means the lake will be less busy and we can go for a long boat ride without getting thrown around too much.
sentences.zh: 我希望这意味着湖上人会少一点，我们可以痛痛快快地开着快艇兜风，而不会被颠得太厉害。

sentences.en: My folks have had a place at Lake of the Ozarks since I was 8 years old.
sentences.zh: 我爸妈自我8岁起就在奥沙克湖有栋房产。

sentences.en: But we came here even before that.

sentences.en: Every summer from as far back as I can recall.
sentences.zh: 从我有记忆以来的每个夏天都是如此。

sentences.en: I think it's safe to say I've been coming here for over 45 years.
sentences.zh: 我想我可以肯定地说，我来这里已经超过45年了。

sentences.en: Older than some of y'all listening.

sentences.en: Yes.

sentences.zh: 谢谢你把这一点挑明。

sentences.en: My parents' place started as a two-bedroom cabin they had built on a spot that I remember first visiting by boat.
sentences.zh: 我父母的房子最初是一个两居室的小屋，是他们在当年我记得第一次乘船来访的地方建的。

sentences.en: It is in a quiet side cove and there is a soft rocky beach and I remember pulling our little red speedboat up onto that shore, tying it to a tree with a long yellow plasticky rope,
sentences.zh: 它在一个安静的小海湾里，有一片卵石和细沙交织的柔缓海滩，我记得当时我们把我们那艘红色小快艇开上岸，用一根长长的黄色塑料绳把它拴在树上，

sentences.en: having a picnic lunch, and watching my parents talk about putting a house there.
sentences.zh: 吃着野餐，看着我父母商量着要在那里建一栋房子。

sentences.en: The soft rocky beach was discussed many times as a big plus.
sentences.zh: 那片柔缓的沙滩曾被反复讨论，被认为是一个巨大的优势。

sentences.en: It meant we could slowly wade into the water from shore while we waited for a dock to be built.
sentences.zh: 这意味着在等待码头建好的那段时间里，我们可以从岸边慢慢涉水走到水里。

sentences.en: Had they already bought the land?
sentences.zh: 他们当时已经买下那块地了吗？

sentences.en: I'm not sure.
sentences.zh: 我不确定。

sentences.en: Again, maybe I should ask about these details.
sentences.zh: 话说回来，也许我该去问问这些细节。

sentences.en: But more than anything, I think it's cool that they made this dream come true for themselves.
sentences.zh: 但最重要的是，我觉得他们能为自己实现这个梦想真的很酷。

sentences.en: I remember driving down over the next year watching as the house was built.
sentences.zh: 我记得第二年开车南下的时候，眼睁睁地看着那栋房子一点点建起来。

sentences.en: All of the anticipatory excitement.
sentences.zh: 所有的期待与兴奋。

sentences.en: Two bedrooms, one bath, a utility room, which also houses the washer dryer and all of my dad's tools, a kitchen living room, and a great big deck facing the lake.
sentences.zh: 两间卧室、一间浴室、一间兼作洗衣机烘干机房以及放我爸所有工具的杂物间、一个起居室兼厨房，还有一个正对湖面的超大露台。

sentences.en: I remember their decision to put their bedroom in the front of the house with a lake view and deck access and our bedroom in the back of the house.
sentences.zh: 我记得他们决定把自己的卧室放在前面，带有湖景和露台出入口，而我们的卧室则在房子后面。

sentences.en: Theirs was small, just big enough for a queen bed and two nightstands.
sentences.zh: 他们的很小，刚好能放下一张双人床和两个床头柜。

sentences.en: Ours was much bigger with bunk beds and a couch and a large walk-in closet, which served as a place to put life vests, overflow food items, skis,
sentences.zh: 我们的要大得多，有双层床、一张沙发和一个大型步入式衣帽间，里面放着救生衣、囤积的食物、滑雪板，

sentences.en: and even a drying rack for swimsuits.
sentences.zh: 甚至还有一个晾泳衣的架子。

sentences.en: That's a big closet.
sentences.zh: 那可真是个大衣帽间。

sentences.en: It was really big.
sentences.zh: 真的很大。

sentences.en: You could almost fit a twin bed in there.
sentences.zh: 你甚至能在里面塞下一张单人床。

sentences.en: It was almost like another room.
sentences.zh: 它简直就像另一个房间。

sentences.en: When we were teenagers, we could put blankets on the ground and hide in the closet for privacy.
sentences.zh: 当我们是青少年时，我们可以在地上铺上毯子，躲在衣帽间里寻求隐私。

sentences.en: Incidentally, the bunk beds had no railing on the upper bunk.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，双层床的上铺是没有护栏的。

sentences.en: It's not like how they are today.
sentences.zh: 不像现在的那些。

sentences.en: And since I was older, I got the top bunk, even though my daredevil sister really wanted it.
sentences.zh: 而且因为我比较大，我睡上铺，尽管我那个喜欢冒险的妹妹其实很想要它。

sentences.en: I fell out of that bed in the middle of the night at least once a year.
sentences.zh: 我每年至少有一次在半夜从那张床上摔下来。

sentences.en: I do feel like our generation was just like, well, just fear it out.
sentences.zh: 我确实觉得我们那代人的态度就是，好吧，自己克服恐惧吧。

sentences.en: No spells.
sentences.zh: 没有防护。

sentences.en: Yeah, you'll be fine.
sentences.zh: 行吧，你会没事的。

sentences.en: And you can lay on the floorboard while we drive.
sentences.zh: 我们开车时你还可以躺在车厢地板上。

sentences.en: The top bunk now belongs to my niece.
sentences.zh: 现在的上铺属于我侄女了。

sentences.en: And we laughed about the fact that she, too, has fallen out in the middle of the night.
sentences.zh: 我们还笑着谈论这样一个事实：她也在半夜摔下来过。

sentences.en: My dad even attempted to add a safety railing, but I guess it didn't work.
sentences.zh: 我爸甚至尝试加装一个安全护栏，但我想没起作用。

sentences.en: So the bed is still...
sentences.zh: 所以那张床依然……

sentences.en: The bunk bed is still there from my childhood.
sentences.zh: 那张自我童年起就在的双层床还在那儿。

sentences.en: It's still taking victims today?
sentences.zh: 它现在还在收割受害者吗？

sentences.en: With no railing.
sentences.zh: 而且还没有护栏。

sentences.en: Well, my sister was like, if my children are going to sleep in this bunk bed, Dad, it needs some sort of railing.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我妹妹当时说，爸，如果我的孩子要睡这张双层床，它得有个什么护栏才行。

sentences.en: But then my niece and I were talking and she was like, oh, yeah, I saw a lot of that.
sentences.zh: 但后来我和我侄女聊天时，她说，哦，对啊，我经常经历那种情况。

sentences.en: Like, let's see.
sentences.zh: 比如，让我想想。

sentences.en: She just went right through the railing?
sentences.zh: 她直接穿过了那个护栏？

sentences.en: Yeah, I guess so.
sentences.zh: 对，我猜是的。

sentences.en: And I was like, oh, no, CeCe.
sentences.zh: 然后我说，哦，不，西西。

sentences.en: We bonded.
sentences.zh: 我们因此建立起了感情。

sentences.en: Moving on.
sentences.zh: 言归正传。

sentences.zh: 我快要把第一天上午的部分讲完了。

sentences.en: A few years ago, my parents expanded the house, adding on a second story and two additional bedrooMs.
sentences.zh: 几年前，我父母扩建了房子，加盖了第二层和另外两间卧室。

sentences.en: It's big enough now that my sister and her kids can come down and stay, but not quite big enough to also house me and Lee and our kids.
sentences.zh: 现在它足够大了，我妹妹和她的孩子们可以过来住，但还不足以同时容纳我和李以及我们的孩子。

sentences.en: So we usually get an Airbnb somewhere nearby.
sentences.zh: 所以我们通常会在附近租个爱彼迎。

sentences.en: Our place this year is great.
sentences.zh: 我们今年住的地方很棒。

sentences.en: I slept so well in the bedroom.

sentences.en: That was in all caps, so well.

sentences.en: But you were like, oh, my God, ladies.
sentences.zh: 但你当时说，哦，天哪，女士们。

sentences.en: I slept so well.

sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.zh: 我写了，床垫很棒。

sentences.zh: 但最棒的是那个带吊扇、正对湖面的巨大带顶露台。

sentences.en: Oh, and there's a mama cat and two little kittens living under the house next door to us.
sentences.zh: 哦，我们隔壁房子下面住着一只母猫和两只小猫。

sentences.zh: 要忍住不去救助这些小猫真的太难了。

sentences.zh: 游泳、坐船、为了买漏带的东西去了一趟杂货铺。

sentences.zh: 我们玩了“名人生死斗”这个游戏。

sentences.zh: 我们有九个人一起玩，三代人一块儿玩感觉挺酷的。

sentences.zh: 我们抽到了理查德·张伯伦这样的名字。

sentences.zh: 我不太确定这说明了他们有多出名，但威尔·法瑞尔在签筒里出现了四次。

sentences.zh: 今天早上，我们一直睡到上午10点。

sentences.en: Glorious.

sentences.zh: 我醒来时看到我姐发来的一条短信，说她和妈妈打算去当地一家叫“希望之家”的旧货店。

sentences.zh: 我妈有些捐赠物要送过去，而且她也很喜欢到处逛逛。

sentences.en: And yet, as of noon, my sister and my mom have still not gone to Hope House, which is pretty typical.

sentences.en: First of all, they realized that the donations they wanted to drop off were in my dad's car,
sentences.zh: 首先，她们发现想捐的东西在我爸的车里，

sentences.en: so they had to wait for him to get back from Walmart.
sentences.zh: 所以她们得等他从沃尔玛回来。

sentences.zh: 不过，这其中带有一点阴阳怪气。

sentences.en: You know what?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: The boys were all, like, thinking they were going to crush us in Celebrity, and they did not win, and they very much did not win.
sentences.zh: 那些男生之前一个个都觉得他们能在“名人猜猜看”游戏里把我们秒杀，结果他们没赢，而且是输得彻彻底底。

sentences.en: Okay, okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧，好吧。

sentences.en: And now, did your mom and sister ever make it to the grocery store?
sentences.zh: 话说回来，你妈和你姐去成超市了吗？

sentences.en: I'll let you know.
sentences.zh: 我一会儿告诉你。

sentences.en: I will let you know.
sentences.zh: 我会告诉你的。

sentences.en: You have to wait for it.
sentences.zh: 你得等等看。

sentences.en: But this is the thing.
sentences.zh: 但关键是这样的。

sentences.en: Like, they'll tell us, oh, the plan for the day is we're going to Hope House at 10 a.m., and then at noon, no one has left.
sentences.zh: 比如说，他们会告诉我们，哦，今天的计划是上午10点去希望之家，然后到了中午，根本没人出门。

sentences.en: This is, like, very typical of my family.
sentences.zh: 这简直太符合我们家的一贯风格了。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: So, anyway, the problem was the stuff was in my dad's car.
sentences.zh: 所以呢，问题在于东西在我爸的车里。

sentences.en: They had to wait for him to get back from Walmart.
sentences.zh: 他们得等他从沃尔玛回来。

sentences.en: They dropped the kids at our place at 12.15, so the cousins are reunited and watching the World Cup.
sentences.zh: 他们12点15分把孩子送到了我们这儿，所以表兄弟们团聚了，正在看世界杯。

sentences.en: And just now, my sister texted me that they made it to Hope House.
sentences.zh: 就在刚才，我姐发短信告诉我他们到希望之家了。

sentences.en: It's 1 p.m.
sentences.zh: 现在下午1点。

sentences.en: It's close.
sentences.zh: 这很接近了。

sentences.en: They're coming back home.
sentences.zh: 他们正在回家路上。

sentences.en: My sister said, Mom, the sign clearly says they are open Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.
sentences.zh: 我姐说，妈，牌子上明明写着他们周一、周三和周五开门。

sentences.en: This was a Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 可那天是周二。

sentences.en: But my mom's response was, yeah, that's what the sign says, but sometimes they're open on Tuesdays.
sentences.zh: 但我妈的反应是，对啊，牌子上是这么写的，但他们有时周二也开门。

sentences.en: They drove all the way there.
sentences.zh: 他们大老远开车去了那里。

sentences.en: I spent the morning reading a play by Gina Gianfrido.
sentences.zh: 我一上午都在读吉娜·吉安弗里多的剧本。

sentences.en: I hope I'm saying her name right.
sentences.zh: 希望我没念错她的名字。

sentences.en: When we were in New York, we saw the revival of her play Becky Shaw, which I absolutely loved.
sentences.zh: 我们在纽约时，看她的复排剧《贝基·肖》，我超级喜欢。

sentences.en: So, now I'm reading her other plays because I love living in her dialogue.
sentences.zh: 所以，我现在在读她的其他剧本，因为我太喜欢沉浸在她的对白里了。

sentences.en: Oh, I just finished the book Yesteryear, which was a trip and a great summer page turner.
sentences.zh: 哦，我刚读完《昔日》那本书，真是一段奇妙的旅程，也是一本适合夏日一口气读完的好书。

sentences.en: It's kind of the book of the moment.
sentences.zh: 这算是当下最火的书了。

sentences.en: It's about a trad wife influencer who suddenly wakes up living an actual pioneer life like in the 1800s.
sentences.zh: 讲的是一个传统娇妻网红突然醒来，过上了19世纪那种真正的拓荒生活。

sentences.en: I read All Fours by Miranda July earlier this year,
sentences.zh: 我今年早些时候读了米兰达·朱莱的《全四方》，

sentences.en: and I feel like reading them both in the same year was very interesting.
sentences.zh: 我觉得同年读这两本书非常有意思。

sentences.en: In both instances, the protagonists are women who feel suffocated by what they perceive to be
sentences.zh: 在这两部作品中，女主角都感到被她们所认为的

sentences.en: the confines of living a married life with children.
sentences.zh: 为人妻母的婚姻生活束缚得喘不过气来。

sentences.en: Very, very different protagonists, but similar theme.
sentences.zh: 两位主角非常非常不同，但主题相似。

sentences.en: They would make an interesting addition to a women's studies course.
sentences.zh: 把它们加入妇女研究课程会是个有趣的补充。

sentences.en: Jenna, again, I'm on the same book train as you.
sentences.zh: 珍娜，又来了，我和你看的是同一本书。

sentences.en: You are?
sentences.zh: 是吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, you and I are three for three on Marriage at Sea, Strangers, and Yesteryear.
sentences.zh: 对啊，你和我对《海上婚姻》、《陌生人》和《昔日》这三本的看法完全一致。

sentences.en: Matt, what did you think of Yesteryear?
sentences.zh: 马特，你觉得《昔日》怎么样？

sentences.en: I loved it.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢。

sentences.en: I thought it was so interesting and funny.
sentences.zh: 我觉得它非常有意思又好笑。

sentences.en: And I don't know, just kind of right on,
sentences.zh: 而且怎么说呢，就觉得很贴切，

sentences.en: kind of a different perspective than I would normally have.
sentences.zh: 带有一种我平时不会有的独特视角。

sentences.en: I agree.
sentences.zh: 我同意。

sentences.en: I really, really liked it.
sentences.zh: 我是真的真的很喜欢。

sentences.en: It was quite a page turner.
sentences.zh: 它确实是一本让人手不释卷的书。

sentences.en: I think I tore through that in about four days.
sentences.zh: 我想我大概四天就把它读完了。

sentences.en: Yeah, totally.
sentences.zh: 对，完全同意。

sentences.en: Let's discuss.
sentences.zh: 我们来讨论一下吧。

sentences.en: We can discuss more.
sentences.zh: 我们可以深入讨论一下。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: I go on to say,
sentences.zh: 接着我要说的是，

sentences.en: but the book I finished recently that has become perhaps my all-time favorite book ever
sentences.zh: 但我最近读完的那本书，或许已经成为了我历年来最喜欢的书

sentences.en: is Station Eleven.
sentences.zh: 那就是《站前十一》。y

sentences.en: In the same way that Demon Copperhead created a fundamental shift in my awareness,
sentences.zh: 就像《恶魔科普海德》彻底改变了我的认知一样，

sentences.en: Station Eleven has too, but on an even deeper level.
sentences.zh: 《站前十一》也是如此，但在更深层次上。

sentences.en: It is a story of a flu that wipes out 99% of humanity.
sentences.zh: 这是一个关于一场流感消灭了百分之九十九人类的故事。

sentences.en: With only 1% of people left, all industry has stopped.
sentences.zh: 只剩下百分之一的人，所有工业都停摆了。

sentences.en: All electricity, food production, transportation.
sentences.zh: 所有的电力、食品生产、交通都停了。

sentences.en: The story centers around a few characters and their experiences in these new times.
sentences.zh: 故事围绕几个角色以及他们在这些新时代的经历展开。

sentences.en: One of the main characters is a member of a troupe of musicians and actors
sentences.zh: 其中一个主要角色是一个音乐家和演员剧团的成员，

sentences.en: who go from settlement to settlement performing Shakespeare and playing music.
sentences.zh: 他们挨个定居点巡回演出莎士比亚戏剧和音乐。

sentences.en: Their commitment to creating art in a world of survival is intensely beautiful.
sentences.zh: 他们在生存世界中对创造艺术的执着美得令人窒息。

sentences.en: They quote a line from Star Trek as their motto,
sentences.zh: 他们引用《星际迷航》里的一句台词作为座右铭，

sentences.en: quote,
sentences.zh: 引号，

sentences.en: because survival is insufficient,
sentences.zh: 因为单单生存是不够的，

sentences.en: which is now maybe my favorite quote ever.
sentences.zh: 这现在可能成了我最喜欢的名言。

sentences.en: It was a spiritual experience for me.
sentences.zh: 对我来说这是一次精神洗礼。

sentences.en: It had me pondering what it means to be human,
sentences.zh: 它让我思考作为人类意味着什么，

sentences.en: the ways in which we are all interconnected during our passage of time on Earth.
sentences.zh: 我们在地球上度过时光时彼此相连的方式。

sentences.en: There is one paragraph about a snow globe that is now my favorite piece of writing.
sentences.zh: 有一段关于雪球的段落现在成了我最喜欢的文字。

sentences.en: I will never forget it.
sentences.zh: 我永远不会忘记它。

sentences.en: I've gone back to it a few times since finishing the book.
sentences.zh: 自从读完这本书后，我又回去读了好几次。

sentences.en: When I read it over again, I feel a deep ache in my stomach
sentences.zh: 当我再次阅读时，我的胃部会隐隐作痛，

sentences.en: because what it evokes is so beautiful, it's hard to hold in my body.
sentences.zh: 因为那种唤起的情感太美了，几乎无法承受。

sentences.en: I will never see a snow globe the same way again.
sentences.zh: 我再也不会用以前的眼光看待雪球了。

sentences.en: My goodness, I need to read that.
sentences.zh: 天哪，我得去读读那本书。

sentences.en: It's absolutely wonderful.
sentences.zh: 这绝对太棒了。

sentences.en: All right, moving on.
sentences.zh: 好了，继续。

sentences.en: I wrote moving on.
sentences.zh: 我写了继续。

sentences.en: Moving on, I have a cat update.
sentences.zh: 接下来，我有个猫咪近况更新。

sentences.en: We fed the mama three meals of wet food yesterday and also left out dry food overnight.
sentences.zh: 我们昨天给猫妈妈喂了三顿湿粮，晚上还留了干粮。

sentences.en: It was all gone in the morning.
sentences.zh: 早上全都吃光了。

sentences.en: She ate well yesterday, but no sign of her babies.
sentences.zh: 她昨天吃得很好，但没看到她的小猫。

sentences.en: Yesterday afternoon, I saw two lake otters also living under the house next door.
sentences.zh: 昨天下午，我看到两只水獭也住在隔壁房子下面。

sentences.en: These people have a small petting zoo living under their deck.
sentences.zh: 这些人家的露台底下居然住着一个小型的抚摸动物园。

sentences.en: I also saw a bunch of geese down by their dock this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上我还看到他们码头边有一群大雁。

sentences.en: Oh, and my folks have a pair of ducks that swim with us and we can feed them out of our hands.
sentences.zh: 哦，我爸妈有一对鸭子会和我们一起游泳，我们还能用手喂它们。

sentences.en: We are also seeing a ton of deer.
sentences.zh: 我们还看到了大量的鹿。

sentences.en: Lots of animals at the lake.
sentences.zh: 湖边有好多动物。

sentences.en: I love it.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢了。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Next day.
sentences.zh: 第二天。

sentences.en: Lake day three.
sentences.zh: 湖畔第三天。

sentences.en: Good morning!
sentences.zh: 大家早上好！

sentences.en: Somebody slept well.
sentences.zh: 有人睡得真香。

sentences.en: Have I mentioned how much I liked this?
sentences.zh: 我提过我有多喜欢这个吗？

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: When we got back to the house last night, the mama cat ran over to the edge of our porch expectantly.
sentences.zh: 昨晚我们回到屋里时，猫妈妈满怀期待地跑到了我们门廊边缘。

sentences.en: We put out some wet food and her two kittens also came up to eat.
sentences.zh: 我们放了一些湿粮，她的两只小猫也上来吃了。

sentences.en: This is when we got our first really good look at them.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们真正看清它们长相的时候。

sentences.en: The mama is a gray tabby.
sentences.zh: 猫妈妈是一只灰色虎斑猫。

sentences.en: She has a gray tabby lookalike kitten, except that her baby has white paws.
sentences.zh: 它有一只长相酷似它的灰色虎斑小猫，只不过小猫长着白色的爪子。

sentences.en: And then there is a super shy, smaller, all black kitten.
sentences.zh: 然后还有一只超级害羞、个头更小、全身漆黑的小猫。

sentences.en: I fed them three plates of wet food.
sentences.zh: 我给它们喂了三盘湿粮。

sentences.en: They could not get enough.
sentences.zh: 它们怎么也吃不够。

sentences.en: My daughter is angling for us to take them back to St. Louis.
sentences.zh: 我女儿正变着法儿想让我们把它们带回圣路易斯。

sentences.en: She looked up the rules for flying them home.
sentences.zh: 她查阅了把它们带上飞机的规定。

sentences.en: I told her that pets must be up to date for their shots in order to fly,
sentences.zh: 我告诉她，宠物必须打完最新的疫苗才能坐飞机，

sentences.en: but she said she read online that, quote,
sentences.zh: 但她说她在网上看到，原话是，

sentences.en: a lot of times Southwest doesn't even check.
sentences.zh: 很多时候西南航空甚至都不会检查。

sentences.en: Oh, no.
sentences.zh: 哦，不。

sentences.en: I said, quote,
sentences.zh: 我说，原话是，

sentences.en: I'm not going to try and take three feral cats on an airplane,
sentences.zh: 我是绝不会尝试带三只野猫坐飞机的，

sentences.en: but I'm feeling the same urge to rescue them as she is.
sentences.zh: 但我跟她一样，也有一种想要救助它们的冲动。

sentences.en: When you have a skill, which for us is cat rescue,
sentences.zh: 当你具备某种技能时，对我们来说就是救助猫咪，

sentences.en: it's hard not to put that skill into action.
sentences.zh: 你很难不去付诸行动。

sentences.en: I also woke up realizing that this is our last full day here,
sentences.zh: 我醒来时还意识到，这是我们在这里的最后一个完整的一天，

sentences.en: which means my last full day with my folks.
sentences.zh: 这也意味着我跟父母在一起的最后一个完整的一天。

sentences.en: My dad is getting older.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸年纪越来越大了。

sentences.en: He turns 80 this year, and I'm always acutely aware that I'm on borrowed time with them.
sentences.zh: 他今年就满80岁了，我总是深深地意识到我和他们在一起的日子是在偷来的时光。

sentences.en: I want to ask them more questions, but I'm not sure what those questions are.
sentences.zh: 我想问他们更多问题，但我不知道该问些什么。

sentences.en: Mostly, I just want to drink them in, particularly my dad here at the lake.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，我只想好好端详他们，尤其是这里湖边的爸爸。

sentences.en: He's always puttering around, doing little chores, even at his age.
sentences.zh: 他总是东忙西忙，做些零碎的杂务，尽管他已经这把年纪了。

sentences.en: Making barbecue ribs for dinner last night was a whole day affair.
sentences.zh: 昨天花了一整天的时间来做晚饭吃的烤排骨。

sentences.en: It's multiple steps.
sentences.zh: 步骤很多。

sentences.en: I'm noticing him in every detail here,
sentences.zh: 我注意到他这里的每一个细节，

sentences.en: like all the do-it-yourself fixes to little problems,
sentences.zh: 比如对各种小问题的DIY修复，

sentences.en: like how he has a special spot to tie up the swim noodles on the dock,
sentences.zh: 比如他在码头上怎么弄了个专用地方来绑游泳面条，

sentences.en: or the sunshade he puts on hooks outside their bedroom window for when the sun is setting.
sentences.zh: 或者太阳落山时，他挂在卧室窗户外面的遮阳篷。

sentences.en: I'm trying to drink it all in.
sentences.zh: 我正努力把这一切都印在脑海里。

sentences.en: Yesterday was another typical lake day.
sentences.zh: 昨天是又一个典型的湖畔日。

sentences.en: Tubing, boat rides, swimming, my dad's delicious barbecue ribs for dinner,
sentences.zh: 玩滑水圈、坐船兜风、游泳、晚餐有爸爸做的美味烤排骨，

sentences.en: my mom's homemade coleslaw, or as she says, cold slaw.
sentences.zh: 妈妈做的自制凉拌卷心菜，或者按她的话说是冷卷心菜。

sentences.en: Another game of celebrity.
sentences.zh: 又玩了一局名人猜猜看。

sentences.en: This time, the boys won.
sentences.zh: 这一次，男孩们赢了。

sentences.en: We said we need to do a tiebreaker tonight.
sentences.zh: 我们说今晚得来场决胜局。

sentences.en: By the way, I'm sorry to George Clooney, but none of the kids knew who he was.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，我对乔治·克鲁尼感到抱歉，但孩子们中没有一个知道他是谁。

sentences.en: Last night, we also did fireworks.
sentences.zh: 昨晚，我们还放了烟花。

sentences.en: They are illegal in Los Angeles, and it's super fun for the kids to do them each year
sentences.zh: 它们在洛杉矶是非法的，孩子们每年在湖边和表兄弟姐妹们一起放烟花，

sentences.en: with their cousins at the lake.
sentences.zh: 觉得超级好玩。

sentences.en: On our drive down, we passed by so many firework stands on the side of the road.
sentences.zh: 在我们开车南下的路上，我们路过了路边的好多烟花摊。

sentences.en: It's such a core memory of my childhood around the 4th of July,
sentences.zh: 路边烟花摊是我对7月4日国庆日童年记忆的核心部分。

sentences.en: the roadside firework stand.
sentences.zh: 路边烟花摊。

sentences.en: We got ours from a little place in front of a gas station near my folks' lake house.
sentences.zh: 我们的烟花是从我父母湖边住宅附近加油站前面的一家小店买的。

sentences.en: We got the usual, chicken, tank, fountains.
sentences.zh: 我们买了常规的，小鸡、坦克、喷泉烟花。

sentences.en: Then we went outside the box and got something called big blue balls,
sentences.zh: 然后我们不走寻常路，买了一种叫大蓝球的东西，

sentences.en: and one that was shaped like a Slurpee.
sentences.zh: 还有一个形状像思乐冰的烟花。

sentences.en: And then we asked the guy at the stand what would make a good finale,
sentences.zh: 接着我们问摊位老板什么东西适合做压轴，

sentences.en: and he pointed us to this giant pack of rockets for like $200.
sentences.zh: 他给我们推荐了一大包价值200美元左右的火箭弹。

sentences.en: Did you get them?
sentences.zh: 你买到了吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: We said, quote, a smaller finale.
sentences.zh: 我们当时说的是，引用原话，一个更小的压轴节目。

sentences.en: We settled on this cube with a dinosaur on it.
sentences.zh: 我们最后选了这个印有恐龙图案的方盒。

sentences.en: It was supposed to have 10 shots inside.
sentences.zh: 它里面本来应该有10发。

sentences.en: He said it would be good.
sentences.zh: 他说这个会很不错。

sentences.en: We had the kids arrange everything in an order.
sentences.zh: 我们让孩子们按顺序把所有东西排好。

sentences.en: We started with the chicken.
sentences.zh: 我们从“小鸡”开始。

sentences.en: It was lame, as expected.
sentences.zh: 不出所料，挺没劲的。

sentences.en: Small tank was lame.
sentences.zh: 小号水雷很无聊。

sentences.en: Medium tank was cool.
sentences.zh: 中号水雷挺酷的。

sentences.en: The exploding blue balls was a fun surprise.
sentences.zh: 爆炸的蓝色气球是个有趣的惊喜。

sentences.en: Slurpee was awesome.
sentences.zh: “思乐冰”太棒了。

sentences.en: That's what she said.
sentences.zh: 她刚才就是这么说的。

sentences.en: It's very funny.
sentences.zh: 这非常搞笑。

sentences.en: Slurpee was awesome.
sentences.zh: “思乐冰”太棒了。

sentences.en: The fountains were fountains.
sentences.zh: 喷泉也就是那么回事。

sentences.en: Then we set up dino box.
sentences.zh: 然后我们布置了恐龙盒。

sentences.en: I would like to repeat that this box was small.
sentences.zh: 我想再次强调，这个盒子很小。

sentences.en: Like, imagine if a softball was a cube.

sentences.zh: 下午4点。

sentences.en: British Airways flight 282 LAX to London Heathrow.
sentences.zh: 英国航空282号航班，从洛杉矶飞往伦敦希思罗。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: I need to be snarky.
sentences.zh: 我得开启讽刺模式了。

sentences.en: My flight attendant is 100% an Angela Martin.
sentences.zh: 我的空乘百分之百是个安吉拉·马丁。

sentences.en: Severe blonde bun.
sentences.zh: 一丝不苟的金发发髻。

sentences.en: So bossy.
sentences.zh: 太盛气凌人了。

sentences.en: She's snippy with everyone.
sentences.zh: 她对谁都言语刻薄。

sentences.en: And she's also a little gossipy.
sentences.zh: 而且她还有点八卦。

sentences.en: I was in line for the bathroom and she was looking at a passenger and whispering to another flight
sentences.zh: 我当时在排队上洗手间，她正看着一个乘客，对另一个空

sentences.en: attendant and then they both started laughing.
sentences.zh: 乘耳语，然后她俩都笑了起来。

sentences.en: I'm trying to figure out who they're talking about.
sentences.zh: 我正琢磨她们在说谁呢。

sentences.en: Maybe the man with the skeleton socks.
sentences.zh: 也许是那个穿着骷髅袜的男士。

sentences.en: He does seem annoying.
sentences.zh: 他确实挺招人烦的。

sentences.en: I had the beet goat cheese salad.
sentences.zh: 我吃了甜菜山羊奶酪沙拉。

sentences.en: I really liked it.
sentences.zh: 我真的很喜欢。

sentences.en: And then I watched the movie Midwinter Break.
sentences.zh: 然后我看了电影《寒冬假期》。

sentences.en: So good.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: This movie deals with traumatic moments that shape us.
sentences.zh: 这部电影探讨了塑造我们人生的创伤时刻。

sentences.en: Marriage ups and downs and the calling to be of greater service through our faith.
sentences.zh: 婚姻的起起落落，以及通过信仰去提供更大奉献的召唤。

sentences.en: It also does a great job of showing that life happens in crowded spaces.
sentences.zh: 它同时也极好地展现了生活就发生在熙熙攘攘的空间里。

sentences.en: Sadness, anger, heartbreak.
sentences.zh: 悲伤、愤怒、心碎。

sentences.en: It can all happen over dinner at a restaurant with tons of people around.
sentences.zh: 这些都可能在一群人围坐的餐厅晚餐时发生。

sentences.en: There is only one sex scene in this movie.
sentences.zh: 这部电影里只有一个性爱场面。

sentences.en: And barely that.
sentences.zh: 而且几乎算不上。

sentences.en: Like you don't see anything.
sentences.zh: 就好像你什么也看不到。

sentences.en: It's just a bunch of sheets.
sentences.zh: 只有一堆床单。

sentences.en: It's between two older people.
sentences.zh: 是两个老年人之间的。

sentences.en: Maybe they're in their late 60s, early 70s.
sentences.zh: 也许他们六十多岁快七十，或者七十出头。

sentences.en: And that is the moment when a dad from our kid's school walked up to me to say hi.
sentences.zh: 就在那个时候，我们孩子学校的一个爸爸走过来跟我打招呼。

sentences.en: I paused the TV and it's two old people, barely clothed in bed together.
sentences.zh: 我暂停了电视，画面上是两个衣衫不整的老人躺在床上。

sentences.en: The dad from the school said, what are you watching?
sentences.zh: 学校的那个爸爸问，你在看什么呢？

sentences.en: Cringe.
sentences.zh: 真尴尬。

sentences.en: July 1st, 10.30 a.m.
sentences.zh: 7月1日上午10点30分。

sentences.en: I just landed at London Heathrow.
sentences.zh: 我刚在伦敦希思罗机场降落。

sentences.en: It's the day after I left L.A.
sentences.zh: 这是我离开洛杉矶的第二天。

sentences.en: and I barely slept on the plane.
sentences.zh: 我在飞机上几乎没怎么睡。

sentences.en: I'm not sure how I'm going to stay awake.
sentences.zh: 我不知道自己要怎么保持清醒。

sentences.en: In my taxi now, the driver's an older man and he said, where to, love?
sentences.zh: 我现在坐在出租车里，司机是个大叔，他问，去哪儿啊，亲爱的？

sentences.en: His name is Andy and I told him my name was Angela and he said, we're the two A's.
sentences.zh: 他叫安迪，我告诉他我叫安吉拉，他说，我们俩名字都是A开头的。

sentences.en: I love him.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢他了。

sentences.en: Traffic getting from the airport to my friend's flat in Highgate was really bad, but I didn't
sentences.zh: 从机场到我朋友在海格ate的公寓，交通状况非常糟糕，但我并不

sentences.en: mind.
sentences.zh: 介意。

sentences.en: I was tired and the taxi had air conditioning.
sentences.zh: 我很累，而且出租车有空调。

sentences.en: I was almost asleep and Andy said, you might get to see the royal family.
sentences.zh: 我快睡着了，安迪说，你可能会见到皇室成员。

sentences.en: So I perked up.
sentences.zh: 所以我一下子来了精神。

sentences.en: On the other side of the freeway, there were a bunch of police on motorcycles clearing the
sentences.zh: 在高速公路的另一边，有一群骑摩托车的警察在为

sentences.en: way for a vehicle motorcade.
sentences.zh: 一支车队开道。

sentences.en: Then three big black SUVs came whizzing by.
sentences.zh: 接着三辆黑色的大型SUV呼啸而过。

sentences.en: Andy said, that's one of the royals.
sentences.zh: 安迪说，那是皇室成员之一。

sentences.en: And then he said, they'll never know what it's like to sit in traffic.
sentences.zh: 然后他说，他们永远不会体会到堵车是什么滋味。

sentences.en: I asked him who he thought it was and he said, maybe the king.
sentences.zh: 我问他觉得那是谁，他说，也许是国王。

sentences.en: Andy said, the king goes back and forth to London and then to Highgrove so he can, quote,
sentences.zh: 安迪说，国王在伦敦和海格罗夫之间往返，这样他就可以，引述原话，

sentences.en: smell his flowers.
sentences.zh: 闻闻他的花香。

sentences.en: I feel like Andy was throwing subtle shade.
sentences.zh: 我觉得安迪刚才在暗暗吐槽。

sentences.en: Andy and I might be related.
sentences.zh: 我和安迪说不定有亲戚关系。

sentences.en: July 2nd, I'm staying at my friend's in Highgate.
sentences.zh: 7月2日，我住在海格特的朋友家。

sentences.en: We walked a ton yesterday.
sentences.zh: 我们昨天走了超多的路。

sentences.en: My friend Betsy says that is the best way to stay awake and fight off jet lag.
sentences.zh: 我的朋友贝茜说，那是保持清醒和克服时差的最佳方法。

sentences.en: Step count, I can't remember, but it was over 17,000.
sentences.zh: 步数记不清了，但超过了17,000步。

sentences.en: Today, we took the tube to Marleybone to meet up with Betsy's friends, Louise and Marina
sentences.zh: 今天，我们坐地铁去马里波恩，和贝茜的朋友路易丝和玛丽娜会合，

sentences.en: for what they call fancy lunch.
sentences.zh: 去吃她们所谓的高级午餐。

sentences.en: So here's what you do for fancy lunch.
sentences.zh: 所以高级午餐的流程是这样的。

sentences.en: First, you meet for tea and biscuits.
sentences.zh: 首先，你们见面喝茶吃饼干。

sentences.en: Then you do some shopping and then you have a fancy lunch.
sentences.zh: 然后逛一会儿街，接着吃高级午餐。

sentences.en: It was fantastic.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: I loved it.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢了。

sentences.en: Then we went back to Highgate to play tennis at the park.
sentences.zh: 然后我们回海格特去公园打网球。

sentences.en: Yes, you guys, I brought my racket all the way to London.
sentences.zh: 是的，各位，我把球拍一路带到了伦敦。

sentences.en: Step count today was crazy, around 19,000.
sentences.zh: 今天的步数太疯狂了，大约19,000步。

sentences.en: July 3rd, I have now played tennis twice in London.
sentences.zh: 7月3日，我现在已经在伦敦打过两次网球了。

sentences.en: I think I'm ready for Wimbledon.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我已经准备好参加温网了。

sentences.en: Ha ha.
sentences.zh: 哈哈。

sentences.en: More walking today.
sentences.zh: 今天继续走路。

sentences.en: Things I took pictures of.
sentences.zh: 我拍了照的东西。

sentences.en: Flowers by the street, lots of hanging flowers, window box flowers, and hydrangeas.
sentences.zh: 街边的花，许多垂吊的花、窗台花箱的花，还有绣球花。

sentences.en: So beautiful.
sentences.zh: 太美了。

sentences.en: Also, I took pictures of ivy that grows on the sides of buildings.
sentences.zh: 我还拍了爬满建筑物侧面的常春藤。

sentences.en: I am driving my friends nuts because I keep stopping to take pictures of flowers.
sentences.zh: 我快把朋友们逼疯了，因为我总是停下来拍花。

sentences.en: Last night, we walked through a park and Mumford & Sons was playing a concert.
sentences.zh: 昨晚，我们穿过一个公园，蒙福乐队正在那里开演唱会。

sentences.en: There was a giant fence and we could hear them from the other side.
sentences.zh: 那里有一道巨大的栅栏，我们在另一边能听到他们的歌声。

sentences.en: There were a lot of people that I guess didn't get tickets or were just enjoying the concert
sentences.zh: 有很多人我想是没有买到票，或者只是在享受演唱会

sentences.en: from outside on the lawn, having wine and picnics.
sentences.zh: 在外面草坪上喝红酒、野餐。

sentences.en: We hung out there for a bit and heard the end of the concert.
sentences.zh: 我们在那儿闲逛了一会儿，听完了音乐会的结尾。

sentences.en: It was a lovely night.
sentences.zh: 这是一个美好的夜晚。

sentences.en: Step count was around 20,000.
sentences.zh: 步数大约是两万步。

sentences.en: July 4th, all my tennis gals have now arrived.
sentences.zh: 7月4日，我所有的网球姐妹现在都到了。

sentences.en: The four of us will be going to Wimbledon together.
sentences.zh: 我们四个人将一起去温布尔登。

sentences.en: I saw a reel on Instagram that says every group of four friends on a trip has a navigator,
sentences.zh: 我在Instagram上看到一个视频，上面说旅行中的每四个朋友里，有一个是导航担当、

sentences.en: a planner, and two that don't know anything.
sentences.zh: 一个规划担当，还有两个什么都不知道的。

sentences.en: Well, I think for us, Betsy is the planner.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我觉得对我们来说，贝茜是规划担当。

sentences.en: Rebecca actually likes to navigate and figure out all the trains and routes.
sentences.zh: 丽贝卡其实很喜欢导航，研究所有的列车和路线。

sentences.en: She told me she enjoys it.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我她很享受这个。

sentences.en: Thank God, because I hate it.
sentences.zh: 谢天谢地，因为我讨厌这个。

sentences.en: Julie is the responsible one who makes sure we all have the things we need.
sentences.zh: 朱莉是那个负责任的人，她确保我们带齐了需要的所有东西。

sentences.en: And I am the historian.
sentences.zh: 而我是历史记录员。

sentences.en: I take all the pictures and document the trip and sometimes drive everyone crazy in the process.
sentences.zh: 我拍下所有的照片，记录这次旅行，有时在这个过程中把大家折腾得够呛。

sentences.en: But they're always happy after the fact to have the pictures.
sentences.zh: 但事后她们总是很高兴能有这些照片。

sentences.en: And you guys know I'm going to scrapbook.
sentences.zh: 而且你们知道我要做手账的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: My next entry is, we are now at an Airbnb near Marble Arch.
sentences.zh: 我的下一篇日记是，我们现在在靠进大理石拱门的爱彼迎。

sentences.en: This morning, we were walking to the tube station near us and there was a big truck going down the
sentences.zh: 今天早上，我们正走向附近的地铁站，有一辆大卡车开过

sentences.en: street and a man was leaning out of the back of it with a special type of water hose.
sentences.zh: 街道，一个男人从车厢后探出半个身子，拿着一种特殊的水管。

sentences.en: It looked like a long pole, but then it had a bend at the end and a nozzle.
sentences.zh: 它看起来像一根长竿，但末端有个弯曲处和一个喷嘴。

sentences.en: He was using it to water the flower pots that hang from the lampposts.
sentences.zh: 他正用它给挂在路灯柱上的花盆浇水。

sentences.en: I cannot tell you how happy that made me to see them being watered and cared for.
sentences.zh: 我无法形容看到它们被浇水和照料时我有多高兴。

sentences.en: I bet you could guess it, but I took a picture.
sentences.zh: 我敢说你能猜到，我拍了张照片。

sentences.en: 1 p.m.
sentences.zh: 下午1点。

sentences.en: Walked through a beautiful park today and there was a cafe where you could get snacks, ice cream,
sentences.zh: 今天穿过了一个美丽的公园，那里有一家咖啡馆，可以买到零食、冰淇淋，

sentences.en: and also buy plants.
sentences.zh: 还可以买植物。

sentences.en: I am in heaven.
sentences.zh: 我置身于天堂。

sentences.en: I took a picture of the sign, Pavilion Cafe.
sentences.zh: 我拍下了那个招牌的照片，馆咖啡厅。

sentences.en: And then as we walked through the park, there was a game of cricket going on.
sentences.zh: 然后当我们穿过公园时，正进行着一场板球比赛。

sentences.en: So we sat on a bench and watched for a while.
sentences.zh: 于是我们坐在长椅上看了一会儿。

sentences.en: I also fell in love with a floppy Datsun named Peanut.
sentences.zh: 我还爱上了一只叫“花生”的垂耳腊肠犬。

sentences.en: I would love a floppy Datsun.
sentences.zh: 我也好想要一只垂耳腊肠犬。

sentences.en: I love any type of dog that looks like a big burrito.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢任何长得像大卷饼的狗。

sentences.en: 3 p.m.
sentences.zh: 下午3点。

sentences.en: Went to the department store Liberty.
sentences.zh: 去了利宝百货。

sentences.en: It's so beautiful.
sentences.zh: 它太漂亮了。

sentences.en: It was founded in 1875.
sentences.zh: 它始建于1875年。

sentences.en: It's several floors tall in an old Tudor style building.
sentences.zh: 它有好多层高，是一座古老的都铎风格建筑。

sentences.en: I love the wooden staircase and the ceiling.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢木质楼梯和天花板。

sentences.en: I bought a cute summer robe with a navy floral design.
sentences.zh: 我买了一件带海军蓝碎花设计的可爱夏日长袍。

sentences.en: Step count today was crazy.
sentences.zh: 今天的步数太疯狂了。

sentences.en: My watch says I climbed 25 flights of stairs.
sentences.zh: 我的手表显示我爬了25层楼。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: You haven't even gotten to Wimbledon yet.
sentences.zh: 你们甚至还没去温布尔登呢。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: I have one day.
sentences.zh: 我还有一天时间。

sentences.en: I forgot that's where this is headed.
sentences.zh: 我忘了事情会发展到这一步。

sentences.en: July 5th, 11 p.m.
sentences.zh: 7月5日，晚上11点。

sentences.en: So tired.
sentences.zh: 好累。

sentences.en: But I wanted to jot down about my day.
sentences.zh: 但我想把今天的事情记下来。

sentences.en: I bought a tin full of tea with Queen Elizabeth's face on it.
sentences.zh: 我买了一罐印有伊丽莎白女王头像的茶。

sentences.en: There were a bunch of different royal family members' faces on tins of tea to choose from.
sentences.zh: 有好多不同王室成员头像的茶罐可以选。

sentences.en: But I went with Queen Elizabeth.
sentences.zh: 但我选了伊丽莎白女王。

sentences.en: I also bought a cute tote bag for Isabel.
sentences.zh: 我还给伊莎贝尔买了一个可爱的托特包。

sentences.en: And a Christmas ornament.
sentences.zh: 还有一个圣诞装饰品。

sentences.en: I always buy an ornament from our travels and the kids love it.
sentences.zh: 我每次旅行都会买一个装饰品，孩子们都很喜欢。

sentences.en: So this year we'll be adding a little figurine of Paddington the Bear to the tree.
sentences.zh: 所以今年我们的圣诞树上会多出一个帕丁顿熊的小塑像。

sentences.en: Oh, and I also went to see the play adaptation of My Neighbor Totoro.
sentences.zh: 哦，对了，我还去看了话剧版的《龙猫》。

sentences.en: I loved it.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢了。

sentences.en: I teared about the end when the cast and puppeteers took their bow.
sentences.zh: 当演员和木偶师谢幕时，看到结尾我都快哭了。

sentences.en: We all stood on our feet and applauded them.
sentences.zh: 我们全都起立为他们鼓掌。

sentences.en: And it's what I love about theater or making TV or film.
sentences.zh: 这也是我热爱戏剧、电视或电影的原因。

sentences.en: So many people behind the scenes that come together to make a piece of art.
sentences.zh: 幕后有那么多人齐心协力创作出了一件艺术品。

sentences.en: It's truly moving.
sentences.zh: 真的很感人。

sentences.en: July 6th, 8 a.m.
sentences.zh: 7月6日，早上8点。

sentences.en: Drinking my tea and steaming my dress.
sentences.zh: 喝着茶，用挂烫机烫我的裙子。

sentences.en: Today I feel like that moment when Michael Scott was screaming,
sentences.zh: 今天我的感觉就像迈克尔·斯科特大喊的那一幕一样，

sentences.en: Oh my God, it's happening!
sentences.zh: 天哪，要发生啦！

sentences.en: Today is Wimbledon!
sentences.zh: 今天是温网！

sentences.en: Ah!
sentences.zh: 啊！

sentences.en: I'm so excited!
sentences.zh: 我太兴奋了！

sentences.en: No time to journal.
sentences.zh: 没时间写日记了。

sentences.en: Must get ready.
sentences.zh: 得去准备了。

sentences.en: Also, my travel steamer is fantastic and tiny and folds up.
sentences.zh: 另外，我的旅行挂烫机太棒了，又小又能折叠。

sentences.en: It's by a company called Next Do.
sentences.zh: 是叫Next Do的公司的产品。

sentences.en: Okay, I felt like that was important to share.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我觉得分享这个很重要。

sentences.en: Okay, July 7th.
sentences.zh: 好吧，7月7日。

sentences.en: Good morning.
sentences.zh: 早安。

sentences.en: I woke up early.
sentences.zh: 我醒得很早。

sentences.en: I couldn't sleep.
sentences.zh: 我睡不着。

sentences.en: I stayed up late with the time difference,
sentences.zh: 由于时差，我熬得很晚，

sentences.en: talking to my mom to tell her every detail of my day at Wimbledon.
sentences.zh: 跟我妈聊天，把我在温网这一天的每个细节都告诉了她。

sentences.en: She was thrilled.
sentences.zh: 她听得兴奋极了。

sentences.en: Yesterday was one of the best days of my life.
sentences.zh: 昨天是我人生中最美好的日子之一。

sentences.en: I don't even know where to begin.
sentences.zh: 我都不知道该从何说起。

sentences.en: I took a ton of pictures and jotted things down in my notes app so I could share in my journal.
sentences.zh: 我拍了大量的照片，并在便签应用里记下了事情，这样我就可以在日记里分享了。

sentences.en: Let's start with my outfit.
sentences.zh: 先从我的穿搭说起吧。

sentences.en: Fit check.
sentences.zh: 穿搭检查。

sentences.en: I wore a green linen dress by Bowdoin and comfy white sneakers with a green trim by Viva.
sentences.zh: 我穿了一条Bowdoin的绿色亚麻连衣裙，还搭配了一双带绿色滚边的舒适小白鞋，牌子是Viva。

sentences.en: I don't know how to say it.
sentences.zh: 我不知道这个词怎么读。

sentences.zh: 然后我还带了一个托特包和一个空水瓶，因为进到里面后你可以重新灌满水。

sentences.en: Sunscreen and a hat.
sentences.zh: 防晒霜和一顶帽子。

sentences.en: Very important.
sentences.zh: 非常重要。
上午9点30分。

sentences.en: We left early to grab some breakfast to go, or as they say here, to take away.
sentences.zh: 我们早早出发去买点外带早餐，或者像这里的人说的那样，带走吃。

sentences.en: And then we took the train from Marble Arch to Wimbledon.
sentences.zh: 然后我们坐火车从大理石拱门出发前往温布尔登。

sentences.en: Thank you to the folks we met at a coffee shop who told us to get off at Southfield Station.
sentences.zh: 感谢我们在咖啡馆遇到的人，他们告诉我们在南菲尔德站下车。

sentences.en: If you guys ever go and take the tube, get off there.
sentences.zh: 如果你们以后去坐伦敦地铁，就在那里下车。

sentences.en: Then you walk to the entrance gates of Wimbledon, and it's not a bad walk.
sentences.zh: 然后步行到温网的入口大门，这段路走起来并不算太累。

sentences.en: About 15 minutes.
sentences.zh: 大约15分钟。

sentences.en: The whole walk to the gates, I had a body buzz.
sentences.zh: 一路上走到大门时，我整个人都兴奋得微颤。

sentences.en: You could feel a joy in the crowd we walked with.
sentences.zh: 你能从和我们同行的人群中感受到一种喜悦。

sentences.en: A huge group of strangers, all dressed in what looked like their Sunday best, excited for the day ahead.
sentences.zh: 一大群素不相识的人，都穿着看起来像他们最好看的衣服，对即将到来的一天充满期待。

sentences.en: 10.30 a.m., walking into the courts, we had four tickets.
sentences.zh: 上午10点30分，走进球场时，我们有四张票。

sentences.en: Two to center court and two to court one.
sentences.zh: 两张是中心球场的，两张是一号球场的。

sentences.en: Throughout the day, we would trade seats so we could see different matches.
sentences.zh: 一整天下来，我们会交换座位，这样就能看不同的比赛。

sentences.en: The first match I saw was on center court.
sentences.zh: 我看的首场比赛是在中心球场。

sentences.en: Walking into that stadium felt like a religious experience.
sentences.zh: 走进那个体育场感觉就像经历了一场宗教仪式。

sentences.en: Our seats were across from the royal box, so I had a great view of Roger Federer and Billie Jean King.
sentences.zh: 我们的座位正对着皇家包厢，所以我把罗杰·费德勒和比利·简·金看得清清楚楚。

sentences.en: OMG!
sentences.zh: 天哪！

sentences.en: The match was amazing.
sentences.zh: 这场比赛太精彩了。

sentences.en: It was Jasmine Paulini and Alexandra Iala, and they absolutely floored me.
sentences.zh: 是贾丝米妮·保利尼对阵亚历山德拉·埃亚拉，她们彻底把我惊艳到了。

sentences.en: We had two very charming men from Italy sitting behind us, and whenever Paulini hit a winner, they would chant,
sentences.zh: 我们身后坐着两个来自意大利的迷人男士，每当保利尼打出制胜分，他们就会高喊：

sentences.en: Bravissimo!
sentences.zh: 太棒了！

sentences.en: Bravissimo!
sentences.zh: 太棒了！

sentences.en: It's such good people watching at Wimbledon, too.
sentences.zh: 在温网看形形色色的人也是一大乐趣。

sentences.en: I met a woman named Jude who had a hat covered in tennis balls, but somehow it was also fashionable.
sentences.zh: 我遇到了一位名叫朱德的女士，她戴着一顶贴满网球的帽子，但不知怎么的，还挺时髦的。

sentences.en: I asked her where she got it, and she told me she made it.
sentences.zh: 我问她是在哪买的，她告诉我是自己做的。

sentences.en: She said, all you need is a glue gun.
sentences.zh: 她说，你只需要一把热熔胶枪。

sentences.en: I got very excited.
sentences.zh: 我变得非常兴奋。

sentences.en: I have a glue gun, and I want to make one.
sentences.zh: 我有一把热熔胶枪，我也想做一个。

sentences.en: Oh, dear.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: And she let me take a picture, lady, of her hat.
sentences.zh: 而且她让我拍了张照片，那位女士，拍了她的帽子。

sentences.en: And I really want to try to make it.
sentences.zh: 我真的很想尝试做一个。

sentences.en: Will I be the crazy lady wearing a hat with tennis balls?
sentences.zh: 我会不会变成那个戴着粘满网球的帽子的疯狂女人？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 会吧。

sentences.en: Maybe.
sentences.zh: 也许会。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Back to my journal.
sentences.zh: 回到我的日记。

sentences.en: Throughout the day, there were so many fantastic matches.
sentences.zh: 这一天里，有太多精彩绝伦的比赛了。

sentences.en: I felt humbled to be there and spent the day in awe.
sentences.zh: 能去到那里让我感到很荣幸，一整天都处于惊叹之中。

sentences.en: There was a moment I won't forget.
sentences.zh: 有一个时刻我永远不会忘记。

sentences.en: It was in the Arthur Ferry and Grigor Dimitrov match.
sentences.zh: 那是在阿瑟·费瑞和格里戈尔·季米特洛夫的比赛中。

sentences.en: Ferry won the wild card slot to play.
sentences.zh: 费瑞赢得了外卡名额得以参赛。

sentences.en: This means he didn't have a high enough ranking to normally get a chance to compete.
sentences.zh: 这意味着他的排名不够高，通常没有机会参赛。

sentences.en: He wouldn't have even been there.
sentences.zh: 他本甚至不会出现在那里。

sentences.en: But he got the wild card.
sentences.zh: 但他获得了外卡。

sentences.en: And Dimitrov has been on the professional tennis circuit around 18 years.
sentences.zh: 而季米特洛夫在职业网球巡回赛上大约已经有18年了。

sentences.en: The energy in that stadium was absolutely electric.
sentences.zh: 那个体育场里的气氛简直热烈爆棚。

sentences.en: They played amazing tennis and went five sets that led then to an insane tiebreaker.
sentences.zh: 他们打出了精彩的网球，打满了五盘，随后迎来了一场疯狂的抢七。

sentences.en: Ferry is from the Wimbledon area.
sentences.zh: 费瑞是温网本地人。

sentences.en: And at one point when the stadium was very quiet, a fan yelled,
sentences.zh: 有一次，当体育场非常安静时，一个球迷大喊：

sentences.en: Go on, Ferry!
sentences.zh: 加油，费瑞！

sentences.en: And the place went nuts.
sentences.zh: 然后全场都疯狂了。

sentences.en: This match could have easily gone either way.
sentences.zh: 这场比赛鹿死谁手真的很难说。

sentences.en: But in the end, Ferry won.
sentences.zh: 但最终，费瑞赢了。

sentences.en: And the place went berserk.
sentences.zh: 整个场面瞬间沸腾了。

sentences.en: Here's this local kid with a wild card now going to the quarterfinals at Wimbledon.
sentences.zh: 这是一个当地的小将，手握外卡，如今闯入了温网的四分之一决赛。

sentences.en: You felt the weight of that moment wash over him and he dropped to the ground.
sentences.zh: 你能感受到那一刻的重压向他袭来，他倒在了地上。

sentences.en: I had to wipe away some tears and I wasn't the only one.
sentences.zh: 我忍不住擦拭泪水，而且流泪的不止我一个。

sentences.en: I looked around that packed stadium and people were crying, hugging, and cheering.
sentences.zh: 我环顾那个座无虚席的球场，人们在哭泣、拥抱和欢呼。

sentences.en: It made me think of our discussion with Mike Schur about fandom.
sentences.zh: 这让我想起了我们与迈克·舒尔关于粉丝文化的讨论。

sentences.en: This one singular moment brought a crowd of strangers together in pure joy.
sentences.zh: 这独一无二的瞬间将一群陌生人紧紧联系在一起，洋溢着纯粹的喜悦。

sentences.en: And the food and drink of it all.
sentences.zh: 还有那里的各种美食和饮品。

sentences.en: Yes, I needed to know if you had strawberries and Pimm's.
sentences.zh: 没错，我得知道你们有没有吃草莓和喝Pimm's酒。

sentences.en: Yes, I had strawberries and cream and a Pimm's.
sentences.zh: 是的，我吃了奶油草莓，还喝了Pimm's酒。

sentences.en: And I got to go into the Wimbledon broadcast building.
sentences.zh: 我甚至有机会参观了温网的转播大楼。

sentences.en: I hopped on the Access All England show, which is a behind-the-scenes live stream on the Wimbledon
sentences.zh: 我上了《Access All England》节目，这是温网

sentences.en: app with my dear friend Nick McCarvel and his co-host and former professional tennis player
sentences.zh: 官方App上的一个幕后直播节目，和我亲爱的朋友尼克·麦卡维尔以及他的联合主持、前职业网球运动员

sentences.en: Jill Krabus.
sentences.zh: 吉尔·克拉布斯一起。

sentences.en: Shout out to everyone in the broadcast building.
sentences.zh: 向转播大楼里的所有人致敬。

sentences.en: They let me keep my giant bag of merch there all day so I didn't have to carry it around.
sentences.zh: 他们让我把一大袋周边商品寄存在那里一整天，这样我就不用到处拎着了。

sentences.en: I think I bought everything they make in the Wimbledon shop because, you know,
sentences.zh: 我想我把温网商店里所有的产品都买下来了，因为你知道的，

sentences.en: I love the merch!
sentences.zh: 我太爱买周边了！

sentences.en: Exclamation point.
sentences.zh: 感叹号。

sentences.en: And I have to share a lovely text I got that night from Beth in the broadcast building.
sentences.zh: 我必须分享一条当晚我收到的来自转播大楼贝丝的可爱短信。

sentences.en: She said,
sentences.zh: 她说：

sentences.en: We're here super late, so let me know whenever you're looking to grab your bits and bobs.
sentences.zh: 我们还要在这待到很晚，所以你什么时候想来拿你的零碎东西随时告诉我。

sentences.en: Do you want me to bring you guys some snacks or anything?
sentences.zh: 要我给你们带点零食什么的吗？

sentences.en: Crisps or chocolate for the journey back?
sentences.zh: 回程路上吃的薯片或巧克力？

sentences.en: We were starving.
sentences.zh: 我们当时饿坏了。

sentences.en: All the food vendors had closed by that time.
sentences.zh: 那个时候所有的食品摊都关门了。

sentences.en: So Beth, thank you for the snacks.
sentences.zh: 所以贝丝，谢谢你的零食。

sentences.en: We ate it on the way home.
sentences.zh: 我们在回家的路上把它吃光了。

sentences.en: I have a video from the end of the day of us,
sentences.zh: 我有一段我们一天结束时的视频，

sentences.en: and we literally closed the place down.
sentences.zh: 我们真的是待到这里关门才走。

sentences.en: We were there over 12 hours.
sentences.zh: 我们在那呆了12个多小时。

sentences.en: I didn't want to leave, and I hope someday I get to go back.
sentences.zh: 我真舍不得离开，希望有一天我还能再来。

sentences.en: Alrighty.
sentences.zh: 好啦。

sentences.en: I've had my Queen Elizabeth tea, and now it's time for my very last day here.
sentences.zh: 我已经喝过伊丽莎白女王茶，现在是在这里的最后一天了。

sentences.en: We're going to Notting Hill and Richmond.
sentences.zh: 我们要去诺丁山和里士满。

sentences.en: And then I have my last day.
sentences.zh: 然后就是我的最后一天。

sentences.en: Okay, last day in London, July 8th.
sentences.zh: 好的，在伦敦的最后一天，7月8日。

sentences.en: Hi from the London Heathrow Airport.
sentences.zh: 伦敦希思罗机场发来问候。

sentences.en: Today I go back home.
sentences.zh: 今天要回家了。

sentences.en: I miss my family, and I'm ready for my bed.
sentences.zh: 我想念家人，也渴望回到自己的床上。

sentences.en: But oh my goodness, do I love London.
sentences.zh: 但是天哪，我是多么热爱伦敦啊。

sentences.en: Yesterday we went to Notting Hill.
sentences.zh: 昨天我们去了诺丁山。

sentences.en: It's as charming as I could have imagined.
sentences.zh: 它比我想象的还要迷人。

sentences.en: I loved all the buildings painted different colors and all the different shops.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢所有涂成不同颜色的建筑和琳琅满目的店铺。

sentences.en: Here's something to know about me.
sentences.zh: 有些关于我的事你得知道。

sentences.en: Again, my journal who doesn't know me, I guess.
sentences.zh: 话说回来，我的日记本可能还不认识我吧，我想。

sentences.en: Never met you.
sentences.zh: 从没见过你呢。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Here's something to know about me.
sentences.zh: 有些关于我的事你得知道。

sentences.en: I love maps.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢地图。

sentences.en: I'm kind of obsessed with maps.
sentences.zh: 我有点痴迷于地图。

sentences.en: I have two different maps hanging as art in my house.
sentences.zh: 我家挂着两张不同的地图作为装饰画。

sentences.en: And for my folks who also like maps,
sentences.zh: 对于同样喜欢地图的朋友们，

sentences.en: there is a fantastic vintage map store in Notting Hill.
sentences.zh: 诺丁山有一家非常棒的复古地图店。

sentences.en: The Portobello Print and Map Shop.
sentences.zh: 波多贝罗版画与地图店。

sentences.en: Listen to what all they have.
sentences.zh: 听听他们都有什么。

sentences.en: Old maps, engravings, plus decorative flower, animal, and maritime prints.
sentences.zh: 旧地图、雕刻版画，还有装饰性的花卉、动物和航海版画。

sentences.en: Um, yes, please.
sentences.zh: 嗯，太好了，来一份。

sentences.en: I really wanted this big map, but I knew I couldn't fit it in my suitcase.
sentences.zh: 我真的很想要这张大地图，但我知道我的行李箱装不下。

sentences.en: So instead, I got this amazing antique engraving dated 1683.
sentences.zh: 所以我买了这个1683年的惊艳古董雕刻版画。

sentences.en: It's of the port in Cartagena with all the old-timey boats pulling in.
sentences.zh: 画的是卡塔赫纳港，上面全都是古老的小船在进港。

sentences.en: It's so cool.
sentences.zh: 酷毙了。

sentences.en: I can't wait to show it to Josh.
sentences.zh: 我迫不及待想给乔什看。

sentences.en: After lunch, we went to Richmond.
sentences.zh: 午饭后，我们去了里士满。

sentences.en: My friend Rebecca lived there for a bit,
sentences.zh: 我的朋友丽贝卡在那里住过一段时间，

sentences.en: and she showed me all of her stomping grounds.
sentences.zh: 她带着我去了她所有常去的地方。

sentences.en: What an absolutely wonderful town.
sentences.zh: 多么美妙的一个小镇啊。

sentences.en: We went to the open bookstore, and I met Madeline, who works there.
sentences.zh: 我们去了那家开放式书店，我遇到了在那里工作的马德琳。

sentences.en: I was looking at books about Anne Boleyn,
sentences.zh: 我当时在看关于安妮·博林的书，

sentences.en: and she took me into a smaller back room and went through a stack of books with me.
sentences.zh: 她把我带到一个较小的里间，跟我一起翻看了一叠书。

sentences.en: I settled on The House of Boleyn by Tracy Borman.
sentences.zh: 我最后选了特雷シー·博尔曼写的《博林家族》。

sentences.en: I can't wait to dive into it.
sentences.zh: 我迫不及待想沉浸其中了。

sentences.en: Before we left the bookstore,
sentences.zh: 在我们离开书店之前，

sentences.en: Madeline gave us a rundown on every prime minister she thought was absolute rubbish.
sentences.zh: 马德琳给我们数落了她认为完全是垃圾的每一位首相。

sentences.en: Her words.
sentences.zh: 原话如此。

sentences.en: I literally said to her, I was like, well, it's nice meeting you.
sentences.zh: 我简直对她说，我说，很高兴认识你。

sentences.en: I'm going to go, and she goes, not yet.
sentences.zh: 我要走了，她说，还没呢。

sentences.en: I have a little snark for you to take home.
sentences.zh: 我有一点刻薄的话要让你带回家。

sentences.en: She continued.
sentences.zh: 她继续说道。

sentences.en: Next, we went to a pub called The White Cross.
sentences.zh: 接着，我们去了一家叫“白十字”的酒吧。

sentences.en: It's famous for being the pub that floods.
sentences.zh: 它以会闹水灾的酒吧而闻名。

sentences.en: It sits right on the Thames River, and as the tide rises later in the day,
sentences.zh: 它就坐落在泰晤士河畔，随着傍晚潮水涨起，

sentences.en: the beer garden and patio at the entrance of the pub flood.
sentences.zh: 酒吧入口处的啤酒花园和露台都会被水淹。

sentences.en: But no worries.
sentences.zh: 不过别担心。

sentences.en: They keep serving drinks and food, even as it floods,
sentences.zh: 即使发水灾，他们也照常提供酒水和食物，

sentences.en: and they have a sign hanging outside that says,
sentences.zh: 而且他们外面挂着一块牌子，上面写着，

sentences.en: can't get in because of high tide?
sentences.zh: 因为涨潮进不来？

sentences.en: Call us to borrow some wellies.
sentences.zh: 打电话给我们借几双威灵顿靴。

sentences.en: Oh.
sentences.zh: 哦。

sentences.en: And then they have their phone number,
sentences.zh: 然后上面有他们的电话号码，

sentences.en: and they'll bring you a pair of wellies.
sentences.zh: 他们会给你送来一双雨靴。

sentences.en: That's nice.
sentences.zh: 真不错。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: I was bummed because we couldn't stay for high tide.
sentences.zh: 我很沮丧，因为我们不能留下来看涨潮。

sentences.en: We had to get back to Marble Arch to pack for our early flight home.
sentences.zh: 我们得赶回大理石拱门，为一早回家的航班收拾行李。

sentences.en: But we did have a glass of wine and watched World Cup,
sentences.zh: 但我们确实喝了一杯酒，看了世界杯，

sentences.en: and I definitely want to go back there.
sentences.zh: 我真的很想再去一次那里。

sentences.en: I have two last things to share.
sentences.zh: 最后我有两件事要分享。

sentences.en: One, I'm going to miss the announcement on the two.
sentences.zh: 第一，我会想念二号线上的语音播报的。

sentences.en: See it.
sentences.zh: 看这个。

sentences.en: Say it.
sentences.zh: 说出来。

sentences.en: Sorted.
sentences.zh: 搞定。

sentences.en: Sorted.
sentences.zh: 搞定。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: My family still says that.
sentences.zh: 我家人现在还这么说。

sentences.en: It's because they say it over and over.
sentences.zh: 就是因为他们翻来覆去地总说。

sentences.en: Say it.
sentences.zh: 说出来。

sentences.en: Sorted.
sentences.zh: 搞定。

sentences.en: Love it.
sentences.zh: 太喜欢了。

sentences.en: And mind the gap, please.
sentences.zh: 上下车请注意空隙。

sentences.en: Mind the gap.
sentences.zh: 注意空隙。

sentences.en: And before I sign off here and get on my plane,
sentences.zh: 在我结束录音并上飞机之前，

sentences.en: I wanted to jot down pubs and great food I've had since I've been here.
sentences.zh: 我想记下我来到这里之后去过的酒吧和吃过的美食。

sentences.en: In North London, in the Highgate area,
sentences.zh: 在伦敦北部的海格特地区，

sentences.en: the Bull and Last,
sentences.zh: 布尔与拉斯特效餐厅，

sentences.en: I got the ricotta stuffed corgut flour,
sentences.zh: 我吃了里科塔奶酪酿櫛瓜花，

sentences.en: Parmesan and honey.
sentences.zh: 还有帕玛森干酪和蜂蜜。

sentences.en: Delicious.
sentences.zh: 美味极了。

sentences.en: The Red Lion and Sun,
sentences.zh: 红狮与太阳酒吧，

sentences.en: I got the chicken schnitzel,
sentences.zh: 我点了鸡肉炸猪排，

sentences.en: jalapeno salsa and Caesar salad.
sentences.zh: 配墨西哥辣椒莎莎酱和凯撒沙拉。

sentences.en: The Flask,
